data.name: Sailendra
data.gender_notes: Sailendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the ocean. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sailendra' which is a combination of two words 'Sai' (Lord) and 'Lendra' (Ocean). The name Sailendra carries the meaning “Owner of the ocean” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sailendra usually hope their child will grow to embody owner of the ocean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and courage to rule over the emotions and the inner self, just like a king rules over his kingdom
data.etymology: Sailendra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Owner of the ocean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sailendra total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Sailendra signifies a powerful and spiritual connection to the ocean, an integral part of Hindu culture. It is a name of reverence for the divine power that governs the vast, mysterious, and life-giving body of water. This name has been borne by many great ruling families in ancient Indian history, evoking a sense of magic, agency, and majesty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Sailendra' also holds spiritual significance as it represents a deep connection to the divine. In Hindu mythology, the ocean is considered an eternal symbol of life, consciousness, and the unmanifested absolute. By invoking the Lord of the Ocean, one acknowledges the interconnectedness of all things and the divine presence within oneself and the elements around us. It is a reminder of the vastness of the universe, the power and wisdom of the divine, and the inner strength and resilience of a person bearing the name Sailendra.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sailendra: Lord of the Sail (Sea) Master of the Voyage of Life These lines symbolize the name Sailendra as an embodiment of the divine sailor, guiding and supporting the journey through life's vast ocean.
